flammability.source: M. G. Zabetakis, Flammability Characteristics of Combustible Gases and Vapors, US Bureau of Mines Bulletin 627 (1965), Table A-1, p. 114, entry "Butene-2": L25 and U25 in air at 25 C and atmospheric pressure. A US Government work (17 U.S.C. 105). Constant with temperature (owner decision E23). The bulletin's one Butene-2 entry, taken for both isomers.
